author: reek
body: The multi-character fill is the case that was wrong and that nothing asked about. These functions repeated the fill once per MISSING CHARACTER rather than padding to the width, which gives the same answer only when the fill is one character long -- and every call site in the tree passes one character, which is why the single-char assertion above held while the pair disagreed with its own prose and with the TextSearch pair it collided with. Padding "a" to 5 with "xy" returned nine characters.
